scripts.docker:migrate: docker run --rm --network etnair_etnair_net -v "${PWD}:/app" -w /app node:18-alpine sh -c "npm install && npx prisma migrate dev"
scripts.docker:generate: docker run --rm --network etnair_etnair_net -v "${PWD}:/app" -w /app node:18-alpine sh -c "npm install && npx prisma generate"
scripts.docker:studio: docker run --rm --network etnair_etnair_net -v "${PWD}:/app" -w /app -p 5555:5555 node:18-alpine sh -c "npm install && npx prisma studio"
scripts.docker:reset: docker run --rm --network etnair_etnair_net -v "${PWD}:/app" -w /app node:18-alpine sh -c "npm install && npx prisma migrate reset --force"
